API reference

Interactive Map of BF session object

Hover or click any attribute/submodule of m to inspect its role, type, and the methods that create or update it.

m = bf(...)
BayesForge.bf Session Root
Central BayesForge session object holding your dataset (m.df, m.data_on_model), modeling building blocks (m.dist, m.effects, m.link, m.net), persistence & datasets (m.save(), m.load()), fitted sampler state (m.model, m.sampler), posterior draws (m.posteriors, m.posteriors_full), and diagnostics (m.diag, m.tab_summary).
Created / updated by: m.fit() m.svi() m.data() m.save() m.load()
